verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents and runtime-probes confirm a hosted per-site Search MCP server (docs.md-style .md export plus /docs/mcp endpoint) that lets AI agents search and retrieve page content, with a full JSON-RPC handshake verified live on Mintlify's own docs site, and this is generated automatically for every customer site. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-Mintlify) confirmation that a customer-deployed site's MCP endpoint works identically outside Mintlify's own docs.
